news.body:
## Today
- Meet Your Class is online this evening, 16:00 Paris, for 45 minutes.
The four in-person admit events are Madrid, Dubai, Toronto and Milan, so this is the only one you can actually get to. Your classmates task has been sitting at the bottom of the board since the start, and an hour online is most of it.

## Tomorrow
- The 1,530 euros for Business Foundations has to be with INSEAD by Friday.
They wrote on Tuesday saying it had not arrived, and they want you to reply to Celine Chin's reminder with the payment proof attached, which is the part most people skip. An international transfer started today may not be credited tomorrow, so the proof is what holds your place while it clears. - Send it this morning if you can, and send the proof the same hour.
